item.title: What happens after you miss three credit card payments?
item.description: Missing three consecutive credit card payments can put your finances at risk in ways that are difficult to undo.

item.title: Top Trump officials heading to Iowa to help GOP campaigns, sources say
item.description: The upcoming Iowa State Fair is a pivotal window of opportunity for candidates on the campaign trail.

item.title: NYC Council probes prediction markets over advertising practices
item.description: New York City lawmakers allege that four major prediction markets engage in deceptive marketing practices and target young adults.

item.title: Breaking down key primary race results in Minnesota and Wisconsin
item.description: Darline Graham and Ralph Norman are advancing to a runoff for Sen. Lindsey Graham's seat, CBS News projects. Meanwhile, moderate David Crowley defeated progressive candidate Francesca Hong in Wisconsin's gubernatorial primary. CBS News' Jonah Kaplan has more.

item.title: Here's how much Social Security's 2027 COLA could rise under new estimates
item.description: Social Security's cost-of-living adjustment for 2027 is projected to be lower than previously forecast, according to new estimates.

item.title: Trump says U.S. has "total control" over Strait of Hormuz
item.description: President Trump said Wednesday that the U.S. has "total control" over the Strait of Hormuz, writing on social media: "I THINK WE WILL KEEP IT."

item.title: Watch Live: Lindsay Clancy jury hearing from mental health counselor
item.description: The jury in Lindsay Clancy's trial is hearing testimony from Latiesha Dukes, a mental health counselor who worked with Clancy.

item.title: Los Angeles Lakers to be sold to Bob Iger, Josh Kushner for $12.5 billion
item.description: The deal comes less than 1 year after Mark Walter purchased a majority stake from the Buss family for about $10 billion.

item.title: Rubio, Bessent took decoy Air Force One, Hegseth flew on secret flight with Trump
item.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent were on the decoy flight last month when President Trump secretly switched to a different plane while Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth was with Mr. Trump.

item.title: Dominic Sessa on playing 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain in new movie "Tony"
item.description: Actor Dominic Sessa and renowned chef Eric Ripert talk with "CBS Mornings" about the new movie "Tony," which is loosely based on Anthony Bourdain's stories of his first experience working in a kitchen restaurant before he found fame. Sessa describes how he got involved and Ripert, who one of Bourdain's best friends, talks about his relationship with the beloved chef.

item.title: Exclusive discounts from CBS Mornings Deals
item.description: On this edition of CBS Mornings Deals, we show you items that will help improve your everyday lifestyle. Visit cbsdeals.com to take advantage of these exclusive deals today. CBS earns commissions on purchases made through cbsdeals.com.

item.title: Top high school quarterback Peyton "Pop" Houston talks NIL deal with Nike
item.description: High school quarterback Peyton "Pop" Houston is one of just 11 elite high school athletes to sign an NIL deal with Nike. He, along with his dad, Shaun Houston, speak to "CBS Mornings" about working together as player and coach, the NIL deal and Peyton's training process.

item.title: Inflation just fell again. Is that good news for mortgage rates?
item.description: Inflation just moved lower for the second month in a row. So, could mortgage interest rates be the next to drop?

item.title: David Crowley beats progressive Francesca Hong in Wisconsin gubernatorial primary
item.description: David Crowley unexpectedly beat a progressive candidate in the Democratic primary for Wisconsin governor, and will face Republican Rep. Tom Tiffany on the ballot in November.

item.title: $1 billion Powerball jackpot on the line in tonight's drawing. Here's what to know.
item.description: The jackpot is the eighth-largest Powerball prize ever.

item.title: What to know about today's total solar eclipse
item.description: The only total solar eclipse of 2026 will cross the Northern Hemisphere on Wednesday, Aug. 12, with a path of totality across parts of Greenland, Iceland and northern Spain. See when and where it will be visible.

item.title: American tourists flock to Europe to experience 2026's only total solar eclipse
item.description: A small part of the U.S. will be able to see a sliver of partial solar eclipse, but the path of totality will cut through Europe. CBS News meteorologist Rob Marciano has more from Mallorca, Spain.

item.title: Trump speaks out on secret Air Force One plane switch after Iran's missile threat
item.description: President Trump is responding to questions after the Secret Service addressed a threat from Iran by covertly moving him to a second plane when leaving Turkey a month ago. "I just have to do what they say," he said. Some aides and journalists were left on board the decoy plane. CBS News' Nancy Cordes has more.

item.title: Becky G opens up about carrying "resentment," pressure as a child to be family's breadwinner
item.description: "CBS Mornings" co-host Gayle King speaks exclusively with pop superstar Becky G about feeling the pressure of becoming her family's breadwinner at a young age.

item.title: Police race to save murder evidence from being turned into scrap metal
item.description: Police say the driver of the minivan — who wore a mask, glasses and a hard hat — sprayed security cameras with blue paint to hide his crime inside an Oregon parking garage.

item.title: CPI report shows inflation eased in July to a 3.4% annual pace
item.description: The CPI report was in line with economists' expectations, marking the second consecutive month with cooler price pressures.

item.title: Sneak peek: Murder in the Parking Garage
item.description: ENCORE: A masked killer spray paints security cameras to hide his crime. "48 Hours" correspondent Natalie Morales reports Saturday, August 15 at 10/9c on CBS and streaming on Paramount+.

item.title: Why some people can't relax while on vacation
item.description: CBS News contributor Arthur C. Brooks talks about the science and history of relaxation while on vacation and why doing nothing comes easier for some people.

item.title: Powerball jackpot hits $1 billion after no one won $905 million grand prize
item.description: No winning tickets were sold for Monday night's $905 million Powerball jackpot, so the estimated grand prize for Wednesday's drawing will be at least $1 billion.

item.title: U.S. Marine veteran freed from Russian prison after nearly 4 years
item.description: A U.S. Marine veteran from Massachusetts who has been held in Russia for more than four years on disputed charges has been released.

item.title: Eli Lilly takes aim at illicit market for its experimental weight-loss drug
item.description: The pharmaceutical company is filing lawsuits against six outlets selling versions of its promising but unapproved weight-loss drug, retatrutide.

item.title: How the Secret Service is cracking down on card-skimming scams
item.description: A Secret Service analyst told CBS News a single skimming device can net a scammer up to $1 million.

item.title: Norah O'Donnell: What I learned from my doctor about menopause
item.description: Norah O'Donnell sat down with her own doctor, Rachel Rubin, to tackle the important topic of menopause: How your body changes, why women may be needlessly suffering, and what you can actually do about it.

item.title: Hospitals push for upfront payments as healthcare costs rise
item.description: Hospitals and other medical providers are increasingly asking for payment before providing care, collecting more of what patients might owe.

item.title: "Pink flags" of postpartum psychosis — and more takeaways from "Healthful"
item.description: Perinatal psychiatrist Dr. Uruj Kamal Haider and Kriti Lodha joined a special edition of "Healthful" to talk more about mental health conditions, including postpartum psychosis​.
